query: Every nonzero multivariate polynomial is a sum of products of univariate and remaining-variable polynomials with both families linearly independent and degree bounds

items.name: MvPolynomial.linearIndependent_X
items.type: ∀ (σ : Type u) (R : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R], LinearIndependent R MvPolynomial.X

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (φ.totalDegree + 1), (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent i) φ = φ

items.name: MvPolynomial.as_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  p = ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.universalFactorizationMapPresentation
items.type:
(R : Type u_1) →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    (n m k : ℕ) →
      (hn : n = m + k) →
        Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
          (TensorProduct R (MvPolynomial (Fin m) R) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) R)) (Fin m ⊕ Fin k) (Fin n)

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_sum_monomial_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = p
